name: Monstergirl Rebellion
source:
This is the trifling epic of a young man named Kaine, and his magical adventure throughout the Monster-Girl land of Fraternia. He is given the task of finding his sister who got kidnapped by the nefarious legion of the Tahali's army. Will Kaine save his beloved family?

Or die trying?

[From [url=https://wonderlanddev.itch.io/monster-girl-rebellion]Itch.io[/url]]
